responses.description: Fitzroy is a club and event space by the Spree. We host diverse crews, club nights and cultural organisations. Contact us for bookings.

links.text: As promised, we’re returning to our beloved home, Fitzroy, to celebrate TANGA’s 3rd anniversary. We can’t believe it’s already been three years. We are super happy and proud of the community we have built and everything we have achieved along the way. None of it would have been possible without all of you who have supported us, danced with us, and believed in TANGA. After a summer of renovations, TANGA opens the doors of the new Fitzroy, and we couldn’t be more excited to return and re-explore our lovenest. For this very special homecoming, we’ve prepared a very special line-up! Let’s celebrate together!

we’re back in rotation, burning bright in full spectrum. come early, stay forever. Daura @da.u.ra Drama Source Artifacts @felix.willi.k Galo @galo_____________ Remove Me @remove_me_ Sookie @sookie.sarah artwork by @jaaaaaanoooo

Simbiosis lands at the mythical Fitzroy for a Sunday day party. Expect a carefully curated journey through deep electronic sounds, featuring local Berlin talent and an intimate dancefloor energy that carries from daylight into the evening. From 14:00 to 22:00, we celebrate the end of summer with friends and new guests, psychedelic visuals, and an afternoon of non-stop dancing! Expect groovy after-hour vibes

After years of throwing parties in apartments with our chosen families and after a long time of wishing and planning - it's finally time. Our first Familiar Feelings party is coming to Fitzroy. We'll meet on our dance floor on the 20th of September, right after you cast your vote in the Berlin election, for a daytime party full of happy Italo. Disco. House. Line up: Gal Kadan Mille David Pearl
24/09 Kosmopolis powered by Au. Die Agentur
Kosmopolis powered by Au. Die Agentur Thursday 24th of September 2026 A to Z: 5RVZ BLUME Harald Uunk Neutran 23:00 - 6:00 Fitzroy Holzmarktstraße 15, 10179 Berlin

Save the date! Walk The Night returns to Fitzroy with Liad Krispin and some special guest, as part of special edition celebration for birthday of David Swartz.

Fixupboy has become one of the most exciting names in the UK's alternative rap scene, blending emo, trap and hyperpop into a sound that's unmistakably his own. Following the breakout success of Pass Out and the viral momentum of his latest single tesla, he's built a rapidly growing global fanbase through emotionally honest songwriting and infectious melodies. Catch him live at in Berlin as he brings his biggest chapter yet to the stage.

links.text: As promised, we’re returning to our beloved home, Fitzroy, to celebrate TANGA’s 3rd anniversary. We can’t believe it’s already been three years. We are super happy and proud of the community we have built and everything we have achieved along the way. None of it would have been possible without all of you who have supported us, danced with us, and believed in TANGA. After a summer of renovations, TANGA opens the doors of the new Fitzroy, and we couldn’t be more excited to return and re-explore our lovenest. For this very special homecoming, we’ve prepared a very special line-up! Let’s celebrate together!

we’re back in rotation, burning bright in full spectrum. come early, stay forever. Daura @da.u.ra Drama Source Artifacts @felix.willi.k Galo @galo_____________ Remove Me @remove_me_ Sookie @sookie.sarah artwork by @jaaaaaanoooo

Simbiosis lands at the mythical Fitzroy for a Sunday day party. Expect a carefully curated journey through deep electronic sounds, featuring local Berlin talent and an intimate dancefloor energy that carries from daylight into the evening. From 14:00 to 22:00, we celebrate the end of summer with friends and new guests, psychedelic visuals, and an afternoon of non-stop dancing! Expect groovy after-hour vibes

After years of throwing parties in apartments with our chosen families and after a long time of wishing and planning - it's finally time. Our first Familiar Feelings party is coming to Fitzroy.
